title: Latchrun
creation_method: MusicSaas Gateway game_bgm / SA3 small stereo master; first 64 seconds form the game mix, full single-pass 128-second master forms the station mix; -9 dB gain before AAC encoding. PCM preflight cannot independently prove inference mode or musical quality; human review remains required.
generation_prompt: This is a continuous excerpt from the MIDDLE of an already-playing full-volume song, not an intro. The first and last beats both have full drums, bass and pitched melody at stable level. Create one ORIGINAL 128-second stereo DRUM AND BASS instrumental for an all-ages one-or-two-key rhythm game at STRICT constant 172 BPM in 4/4. Program original tight fast breakbeat drums with strong kick on beats one and three, crisp snare on two and four, precise eighth and sixteenth hats, an extra short pitched click on every quarter beat, and a clean moving sub-bass. Signature hook: four clipped metallic-but-musical notes run in a stepped pattern, then a contrasting two-note rounded synth answer lands across the next bar; the pair evokes two latches opening in sequence. At 64 seconds keep the same fast drum grid and volume while changing bass roots, invert the stepped phrase and use new syncopated responses. Every 8-second span has clear drum and pitched attacks, without an exact copied half. No quiet intro, half-time breakdown, long build, fade, silent tail, tempo drift, harsh distortion, vocals, speech, recorded break samples, known melody or imitation of another song.

art_provenance.cover_prompt: Original high-contrast comic-print cover: two offset blank latch brackets frame a compact zigzag cyan beat trail, with one coral square impact in the center and three ivory speed notches. Dynamic but readable in a 100px crop; no vehicles, logos or copied game art.
art_provenance.og_prompt: Original wide duohertz sharing card with two offset latch brackets and a cyan zigzag beat trail on the right, clear lowercase duohertz and Latchrun on the left. Dark paper-cut graphic language, not a stretched square.
art_provenance.render_method: local macOS sips SVG-to-PNG; source raster equality checked before staging
